spans.s: ghād̤ā (Chamba), a system by which the tiller receives one half of the produce. See ghād̤otā.
ghād̤aka, also called ghād̤ī (Chamba); land cultivated on the ghād̤ā system.
ghād̤otā (Chamba), spoken of a land tilled on the condition that one half of the produce should go to the owner. See ghād̤ā, etc.
